_comment: Generated by tools/blender/build_kage.py (lib/daggers.py). Times in seconds; root = forward metres per frame at 30 fps. Do not edit by hand.

Pose_Daggers_Finisher_Plunge.desc: Kage-nui: both blades driven down into the collarbones of a reeling foe.
Pose_Daggers_Finisher_Plunge.name: Finisher Plunge

Pose_Daggers_Guard.desc: Kage no kamae. Low bladed stance, lead dagger forward along the forearm, rear dagger cocked at the sternum.
Pose_Daggers_Guard.name: Guard

Pose_Daggers_Guard_Breathe.desc: Exhale of the guard loop: shoulders settle, hands sink a finger's width.
Pose_Daggers_Guard_Breathe.name: Guard Breathe

Pose_Daggers_Guard_Cross.desc: Juji-uke. Forearms crossed before the face, blades flared out: the block.
Pose_Daggers_Guard_Cross.name: Guard Cross

Pose_Daggers_Guard_Low.desc: Kasumi. Predator crouch: both blades low and wide, weight forward.
Pose_Daggers_Guard_Low.name: Guard Low

Pose_Daggers_Heavy_Drop.desc: Both blades drop in a closing X; land in a crouch on the cut.
Pose_Daggers_Heavy_Drop.name: Heavy Drop

Pose_Daggers_Heavy_Leap.desc: Kage-otoshi: off the ground, both blades raised high behind the head.
Pose_Daggers_Heavy_Leap.name: Heavy Leap

Pose_Daggers_L1_Cut.desc: Hips snap through, the rear blade crosses the centre line at throat height.
Pose_Daggers_L1_Cut.name: L1 Cut

Pose_Daggers_L1_Follow.desc: Blade runs on past the body; rear shoulder rolls over the lead knee.
Pose_Daggers_L1_Follow.name: L1 Follow

Pose_Daggers_L1_Link.desc: Loaded for the backhand: chest wound left, lead blade raised behind the ear.
Pose_Daggers_L1_Link.name: L1 Link

Pose_Daggers_L1_Wind.desc: Coil right: hips close, rear fist pulled back beside the shoulder.
Pose_Daggers_L1_Wind.name: L1 Wind

Pose_Daggers_L2_Cut.desc: The crescent falls: lead blade cuts down across the chest line.
Pose_Daggers_L2_Cut.name: L2 Cut

Pose_Daggers_L2_Follow.desc: Blade finishes low by the rear hip, torso folded over the lead leg.
Pose_Daggers_L2_Follow.name: L2 Follow

Pose_Daggers_L2_Link.desc: Coiled right and low; rear fist cocked under the ribs for the rising cut.
Pose_Daggers_L2_Link.name: L2 Link

Pose_Daggers_L2_Wind.desc: Rise onto the balls of the feet, lead blade high over the left shoulder.
Pose_Daggers_L2_Wind.name: L2 Wind

Pose_Daggers_L3_Cut.desc: Step through to right lead; the rear blade rises from hip to opposite shoulder.
Pose_Daggers_L3_Cut.name: L3 Cut

Pose_Daggers_L3_Follow.desc: Rising cut spends itself high left; weight settles on the new lead leg.
Pose_Daggers_L3_Follow.name: L3 Follow

Pose_Daggers_L3_Link.desc: Right lead, both blades gathered at the chest, hips loaded for the spin.
Pose_Daggers_L3_Link.name: L3 Link

Pose_Daggers_L4_Land.desc: Land low out of the turn, lead blade still sweeping, rear arm thrown back.
Pose_Daggers_L4_Land.name: L4 Land

Pose_Daggers_L4_Link.desc: Gathered low in left lead, both fists chambered at the hips for the thrust.
Pose_Daggers_L4_Link.name: L4 Link

Pose_Daggers_L4_Spin.desc: Mid-turn: arms flung wide, both blades out like a pinwheel.
Pose_Daggers_L4_Spin.name: L4 Spin

Pose_Daggers_L5_Thrust.desc: Full lunge: both hammer-fists driven through, blades level with the target's heart.
Pose_Daggers_L5_Thrust.name: L5 Thrust

Pose_Daggers_Rising_Cross.desc: Tsubame-gaeshi: rising scissor cut that lifts the foe off balance.
Pose_Daggers_Rising_Cross.name: Rising Cross

Pose_Daggers_Run_Ready.desc: Sprint carriage: chest over the lead knee, blades trailing behind the forearms.
Pose_Daggers_Run_Ready.name: Run Ready
